original.statement: The v1beta1 EC2NodeClass schema default for spec.metadataOptions changed so httpPutResponseHopLimit goes from 2 to 1 (other sub-defaults unchanged) for objects leaving the field unset.

decision.reason: The computed artifact diff, backed by the v0.37.8 and v1.0.0 EC2NodeClass CRDs [ev-8998581760b8, ev-451bd6a12e72], shows that the v1beta1 schema default of spec.metadataOptions changed from the object with httpPutResponseHopLimit 2 to the same object with httpPutResponseHopLimit 1. The crd-schema:default validator confirmed these exact before and after defaults, and the crd-schema:field validator confirmed the subject exists in both releases. P1 used the narrower subfield path and was refuted; that refutation does not apply to this assertion, which names the whole object field.
